description: Manage live match tracking for SportyBet, Football.com, and Betway slips. Actions: 'start' (costs 1 credit; mode 'ticket' fast-fails on a cut, 'game' tracks to the end), 'get' (0 credits), 'list' (0 credits), 'stop' (0 credits).

mode.description: 'ticket' (fast-fail on a losing game) or 'game' (track all games to the end).

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook URL on port 443/8443 for 'start'.

name: mbc_manage_tracking
title: Start, Inspect, List, or Stop Live Tracking
